mapper.select: /*AdminLoginDAO.selectAdmUserBasByAuth 로그인 사용자조회 */ SELECT A.USER_ID , A.DESIG_IP , A.USER_PWD , A.ADM_USER_STUS_CD , A.USER_NM , A.CP_NO , A.EMAIL , A.BROFC_CD , A.LAST_PWD_CHNG_DT , A.PWD_ERR_NOTMS FROM ADM_USER_BAS A WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ADM_USER_BAS SET PWD_ERR_NOTMS = (SELECT IFNULL(PWD_ERR_NOTMS, 0)+1 FROM ADM_USER_BAS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) ,LAST_CHNG_USER_ID = 'SYSTEM' ,LAST_CHNG_TMSP = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ADM_USER_BAS_HST SELECT * FROM ADM_USER_BAS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT A.GROUP_ID FROM ADM_GROUP_USER_REL A INNER JOIN ADM_GROUP_BAS B ON B.GROUP_ID = A.GROUP_ID WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.GROUP_DV_CD = '10' /* 메인그룹 */ AND A.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT T.SCREN_TRAN_ID , CONCAT(T.SCREN_TRAN_ID, '_LNB') AS SCREN_TRAN_LNB_ID , (CASE WHEN T.UP_SCREN_TRAN_ID IS NULL THEN '#' ELSE CONCAT(T.UP_SCREN_TRAN_ID, '_LNB') END) AS UP_SCREN_TRAN_ID , T.SCREN_TRAN_DV_CD , T.URL_ADDR , T.SCREN_TRAN_NM , T.SCREN_TRAN_LVEL , T.REPST_ORDR , T.MENU_REPST_YN , T.SSTV_INFO_YN FROM ( WITH RECURSIVE CTR AS ( SELECT A.*, 1 AS MENU_LEVEL, CONCAT(LPAD(1, 5, '0'), '.', A.REPST_ORDR) AS HIERARCHY FROM ( SELECT A.* FROM ADM_SCREN_TRAN_BAS A WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.WHOL_ALLOW_YN = 'Y'
UNION
SELECT A.* FROM ADM_SCREN_TRAN_BAS A INNER JOIN ADM_GROUP_ATH B ON B.GROUP_ID IN (SELECT GROUP_ID FROM ADM_GROUP_USER_REL WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND USE_YN = 'Y') AND B.SCREN_TRAN_ID = A.SCREN_TRAN_ID WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y'
UNION
SELECT A.* FROM ADM_SCREN_TRAN_BAS A INNER JOIN ADM_USER_ATH C ON C.USER_ID = #{userId} AND C.SCREN_TRAN_ID = A.SCREN_TRAN_ID WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ) A WHERE A.SCREN_TRAN_LVEL = 0 UNION ALL SELECT B.*, C.MENU_LEVEL + 1 AS MENU_LEVEL, CONCAT(LPAD(C.MENU_LEVEL + 1, 5, '0'), '.', B.REPST_ORDR) AS HIERARCHY FROM ( SELECT A.* FROM ADM_SCREN_TRAN_BAS A WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.WHOL_ALLOW_YN = 'Y'
UNION
SELECT A.* FROM ADM_SCREN_TRAN_BAS A INNER JOIN ADM_GROUP_ATH B ON B.GROUP_ID IN (SELECT GROUP_ID FROM ADM_GROUP_USER_REL WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND USE_YN = 'Y') AND B.SCREN_TRAN_ID = A.SCREN_TRAN_ID WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y'
UNION
SELECT A.* FROM ADM_SCREN_TRAN_BAS A INNER JOIN ADM_USER_ATH C ON C.USER_ID = #{userId} AND C.SCREN_TRAN_ID = A.SCREN_TRAN_ID WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ) B INNER JOIN CTR C ON B.UP_SCREN_TRAN_ID = C.SCREN_TRAN_ID ) SELECT * FROM CTR ) T ORDER BY HIERARCHY

SELECT T.SCREN_TRAN_ID , CONCAT(T.SCREN_TRAN_ID, '_LNB') AS SCREN_TRAN_LNB_ID , (CASE WHEN T.UP_SCREN_TRAN_ID IS NULL THEN '#' ELSE CONCAT(T.UP_SCREN_TRAN_ID, '_LNB') END) AS UP_SCREN_TRAN_ID , T.SCREN_TRAN_DV_CD , T.URL_ADDR , T.SCREN_TRAN_NM , T.SCREN_TRAN_LVEL , T.REPST_ORDR , T.MENU_REPST_YN , T.SSTV_INFO_YN FROM ( WITH RECURSIVE CTR AS ( SELECT A.*, 1 AS MENU_LEVEL, CONCAT(LPAD(1, 5, '0'), '.', A.REPST_ORDR) AS HIERARCHY FROM ADM_SCREN_TRAN_BAS A WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.SCREN_TRAN_LVEL = 0 UNION ALL SELECT B.*, C.MENU_LEVEL + 1 AS MENU_LEVEL, CONCAT(LPAD(C.MENU_LEVEL + 1, 5, '0'), '.', B.REPST_ORDR) AS HIERARCHY FROM ADM_SCREN_TRAN_BAS B INNER JOIN CTR C ON B.UP_SCREN_TRAN_ID = C.SCREN_TRAN_ID WHERE B.USE_YN = 'Y' ) SELECT * FROM CTR ) T ORDER BY HIERARCHY
SELECT USER_ID , FVRT_CTNT FROM ADM_USER_FVRT_DTL WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
